minutes.headline: Select Board authorized emergency deficit spending for the burst-pipe library damage and adopted two workplace policies.
minutes.summary: The board adopted workplace violence and domestic violence leave policies, proclaimed Boys and Girls Club week, and voted emergency spending for library pipe damage, expected to be covered by insurance. It discussed the FY16 budget and the need for prioritized goals, ending sand and salt for residents, a planning board workshop on stormwater and bylaws, and forming a committee for the cable license renewal. Committee reports and a governor's budget update followed.

what_happened.line: The Select Board voted to authorize an emergency expenditure for library pipe damage, allowing deficit spending that is expected to be reimbursed by insurance.
The board adopted the workplace violence and domestic violence leave policies.
The board discussed the FY16 budget and goal setting without resolution, and agreed to leave the budget on agendas through Town Meeting.
Members favored ending the sand and salt program for residents; the decision was left to the spring.
Three members volunteered for a cable license renewal committee, and the public hearing date was deferred to next week.

why_it_matters: The library repair is not in the budget, so it is paid by deficit spending first and relies on an insurance reimbursement; if that falls short, the cost lands on the town budget, mostly taxes.
Ending sand and salt for residents would remove a free service some households use, and the board has left that choice to the spring.
The FY16 budget stays open through Town Meeting, where residents will be asked to vote on it.
watch_next: The cable license public hearing, deferred to next week.
The spring decision on the sand and salt program, and the FY16 budget on agendas through Town Meeting.
